question: Given a + b + c = 15 and a² + b² + c² = 83 , find ab + bc + ca .
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use identity: (a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca)

15² = 83 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

225 = 83 + 2x

2x = 142 ⇒ x = 71

**∴ Answer = 71**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

a + b + c = 15, a² + b² + c² = 83

**Formula used:**

(a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca)

**Calculation:**

⇒ (15)² = 83 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 225 = 83 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 2(ab + bc + ca) = 225 − 83 = 142

⇒ ab + bc + ca = 142 ÷ 2 = 71

**∴ The correct answer is 71.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identity

(a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca)

Key Idea

Use identity to relate sum and squares

Shortcut Insight

Always square the sum when cross terms are needed
